notes.message: Text layers (#166), each a TEXT node with a TEXT property: Value: SelectValue's placeholder (code.child SelectValue, childProp placeholder), coloured as Select's data-placeholder rules colour it, since the Trigger carries data-placeholder while no value is picked. Each one's text style (font-size, line-height, font-weight) and colour are its own utilities, then what it inherits from Select, then app/globals.css's base layer (html line-height, body color). Each binds the Text Style its size and weight utilities name where it holds those values, else its text style is raw, saying why (#160); the default text is a Drafted value.

Select (components/ui/select.tsx:8) renders SelectPrimitive.Root, a provider with no box of its own, so this Contract is read from SelectTrigger (components/ui/select.tsx:33), the box a designer sees; code.component stays Select. In code, invalid is styled on SelectTrigger, not on Select. The other exports (SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem, SelectSeparator, SelectScrollUpButton, SelectScrollDownButton) render inside SelectTrigger or in the popup it opens, so none is a part, and the options a Usage lists (code.items, ADR 0013) are not drafted.

data-[size=sm]:h-7, data-[size=sm]:rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)]: under size "sm". size is a prop of SelectTrigger that no axis reads (only a cva variant is an axis), so every variant renders its default "default". Not carried.

*:data-[slot=select-value]:flex, *:data-[slot=select-value]:gap-1.5, *:data-[slot=select-value]:items-center, *:data-[slot=select-value]:line-clamp-1: Styled by an ancestor; that is a Mode or the parent's Contract (ADR 0012). Not carried.

[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4, [&_svg]:pointer-events-none, [&_svg]:shrink-0: Styles a descendant other than a slot frame or a part; the anatomy below them is not drafted yet (agent tier). Not carried.
data-placeholder:text-muted-foreground, text-sm, whitespace-nowrap: Text utilities: read only into the text layers' textStyle and fill (see the anatomy notes), not carried on the root.
disabled:cursor-not-allowed, outline-none, select-none, transition-colors: No Contract field carries these properties. Not carried.
